steps.en: Install it and export the target provider's API key
steps.zh: 安装，并导出目标服务商的 API key

steps.en: Name the model to scan and the probe families to run
steps.zh: 指定要扫的模型和要跑的探针类别

steps.en: Sends every attack prompt of those probes to the model, several generations each
steps.zh: 把这些探针的攻击提示逐条发给模型，每条生成多次

steps.en: Runs each probe's detectors on the replies and prints a failure rate per probe
steps.zh: 用每个探针配套的检测器判读回复，按探针输出失败率

steps.en: Writes a JSONL report and a hit log of the prompts that made the model fail
steps.zh: 写出 JSONL 报告和一份命中日志，列出让模型失守的提示

value.en: A repeatable, per-attack failure rate for a model before launch, instead of a handful of jailbreaks tried by hand
value.zh: 上线前拿到可重复的、按攻击类型统计的失败率，而不是手动试几个越狱提示
